title: Spicy Japanese Ramen Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and spicy Japanese-inspired noodle soup made with ramen noodles, tofu, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: 1. Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a large pot or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
3. Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
6. Add the red pepper flakes, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and stir to combine.
7. Add the cooked ramen noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
8. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated in the sauce.
9. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
